aries: Jul 29, 2026- Much has happened recently, Aries. Have you allowed enough time to process it? It's likely that big changes are brewing at home or work. Stay focused on the job at hand rather than fret about events over which you have no control. You may feel as if you're on a roller-coaster ride, but everything will settle down in a few days. Blink to adjust your eyes to the strange new light.
taurus: Jul 29, 2026- You've made progress these past few weeks, especially where your temper is concerned, Taurus. It has taken some effort, but it does seem that you can overcome your tendency to speak before thinking. Don't lose the ground you've gained. There's one person whose mission seems to be to make you explode. Don't let him or her rankle you. Take a deep breath and rise above it.
gemini: Jul 29, 2026- This is likely to be an intense day, Gemini. Family and friends may seem testy, so you're advised to stay out of their way. Don't worry - it isn't anything you've done. It's the planetary energy. If you can go someplace private and shut the door, do it. If someone tries to pick a fight, don't rise to the bait. Tomorrow the air will clear and good spirits will reign again.
cancer: Jul 29, 2026- This isn't the most cheerful time, Cancer, because important issues are rearing their heads again and forcing you to address them. You'd rather not, but you can't wish them away. The time has come to deal with them once and for all. It's especially important that you make an effort to make your home life more positive and upbeat. Your loved ones look to you to set the tone.
leo: Jul 29, 2026- Don't try to force anything or anyone right now, Leo. You'll find that today's elements are just as stubborn as you are. Today's planetary configurations will force you to finally start to turn your dreams into reality, whether you want to or not. Face it - you've been planning for a long time without making much concrete progress. All that is about to change.
virgo: Jul 29, 2026- You're incredibly productive, with good business sense, Virgo. However, lately you may have felt dissatisfied with where you are in life. As you look around, you might wish you had more possessions to show for all your hard work. Don't pursue this line of thought. Real value comes from relationships and the pride you get from doing a job well. A new car or fancy clothes may lift your spirits, but it's superficial.
libra: Jul 29, 2026- You have a keen analytical mind that has served you well in business. Alas, Libra, this characteristic doesn't always serve you well in your personal life. Correct any unintentional slights. A simple "I'm sorry," will do wonders.
scorpio: Jul 29, 2026- This is the beginning of an exciting period in your love life, Scorpio. Your relationship with a significant other may have been in a rut lately, but that's about to change. Follow your instincts, because they'll lead you where you're meant to go.
sagittarius: Jul 29, 2026- You have a passionate nature, Sagittarius. Sometimes it's difficult for you when other people don't share your exuberance. This is a good time to tone things down a notch. There's some tension in the air, and your enthusiasm only serves to annoy rather than charm, as it usually does. Don't pout. It's only temporary. Tomorrow you'll be the center of attention again and bestowing hugs and kisses to all.
capricorn: Jul 29, 2026- This is going to be a rather intense day, Capricorn. On the positive side, you'll accomplish a lot. On the less positive side, you may be exhausted by the end of the day. Keep the big picture in mind and the little things will take care of themselves.
aquarius: Jul 29, 2026- Today it's important that you make your own decisions and stick with them, Aquarius. Much as you prefer to depend on others, your judgment really is best. pisces: Jul 29, 2026- You're a dreamer, Pisces. Everyone loves you for it, but today the planetary aspects urge practicality.
